content.title: Good Friday 2025: Which US schools and colleges will close?
content.text: Will US schools stay open on Good Friday 2025?Good Friday, observed on April 18, 2025, commemorates the crucifixion of Jesus Christ and is a significant Christian holiday. It is not a federal holiday in the US, meaning public schools and colleges are not required to close. However, closures vary by state, district, and institution. Twelve states—Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Hawaii, Indiana, Kentucky, Louisiana, North Carolina, North Dakota, New Jersey, Tennessee, and Texas—recognize Good Friday as a state holiday, typically closing public schools and colleges. Kentucky observes it as a half-day, while Texas lists it as optional.In states without a Good Friday holiday, decisions rest with local school districts and colleges. For example, New York City public schools close, per their academic calendar, while other districts may remain open. Catholic and private Christian schools often close to honor the holy day, aligning with traditions like fasting and prayer. Some public schools schedule spring break to include Good Friday, giving students the day off indirectly.Colleges may stay open but offer accommodations, such as excused absences, for students observing the holiday. Students and parents should check academic calendars or contact institutions to confirm closures, as regional practices differ. Businesses, including banks and post offices, generally operate, though some banks in holiday states may have reduced hours. The NYSE and NASDAQ will close, reflecting Good Friday’s financial market tradition.To plan effectively, verify local schedules, especially in non-holiday states, and communicate with school administrations for religious accommodations. Good Friday’s observance highlights the diversity of US holiday practices, balancing religious significance with operational needs.US states with Good Friday as a state holiday• Connecticut• Delaware• Florida• Hawaii• Indiana• Kentucky (half-day)• Louisiana• North Carolina• North Dakota• New Jersey• Tennessee• Texas (optional)What’s open and closed on Good Friday 2025On Good Friday, April 18, 2025, most US businesses, including retail stores, restaurants, and federal services like USPS, remain open, as it’s not a federal holiday. Banks typically operate, though some in states recognizing the holiday may close early. The NYSE and NASDAQ will be closed, following tradition. Government offices in the 12 states observing Good Friday as a state holiday are likely closed, while others stay open. Always check local hours for specific closures.
